title: Lovely
desc: Mahadevan does not believe in love and hates the word, but his daughter Nivedha loves Chandru. In order to get his consent, the couple comes up with an intricate plan and executes it.

title: Kathanayagan
desc: A revenue inspector falls in love with a girl but faces problems due to his cowardliness. He is compelled to find a way to prove himself to her father, who wants her to marry a brave man.

title: Naan Sivappu Manithan
desc: A Tamil professor and his friend try to stop the prostitution and illicit liquor trade in their neighbourhood. However, due to their work, a criminal gang begins to attack their families.

title: Vaaimaiye Vellum
desc: Raja is hired by a journalist, who is investigating the kidnapping of rich children, to protect his daughter. In turn, Raja earns the enmity of the criminals behind the operation.

title: Satyam
desc: Sathyam, an honest policeman, believes in punishing the criminals in a judicial way. When he is assigned to capture a murderer, he is taken aback as he is none other than his paragon.
